name: Pieter van der Merwe
bio:
Pieter's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While working as a mechanic at a local garage in Johannesburg, he caught the eye of a small racing team with his meticulous attention to detail and ability to diagnose complex mechanical issues swiftly. They offered him a role as a junior mechanic, and Pieter quickly rose through the ranks, becoming a key figure in their race preparation. His knack for understanding vehicle dynamics and translating driver feedback into actionable adjustments led him to his current role as test driver coordinator for Hitech Development.

Pieter's approach is deeply rooted in practical experience and data analysis. He meticulously plans and executes test sessions, ensuring that every run yields valuable insights. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to bridge the gap between engineers and drivers, fostering a collaborative environment that encourages open communication and continuous improvement. His pragmatic approach, combined with his innovative ideas, makes him a valuable asset to any team.

physical.description: Pieter is a stout man with a weathered face and kind eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Insists on drinking Rooibos tea before every test session.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
